# Release Gate Checklist: Full Preset Library Unlock

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality gate after the plan: purchase and entitlement, large-library browsing and scopes, privacy amendments, measurability
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for every purchase outcome (success, cancel, failure, pending, restricted, store unavailable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-108, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the content of the purchase sheet (price, packs, counts, Buy, Restore, Close) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-106]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for how a refund affects the playing preset, favorites and scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-109]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is every scope kind listed with how it is chosen and whether it persists? [Completeness, Spec §FR-116, §FR-119]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the browsing structures of all four packs specified, including the one without folders? [Completeness, Spec §FR-112]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are attribution requirements defined per pack (source, version, license, authors)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-121]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for presets removed at an author's request and for presets that fail before release? [Completeness, Spec §FR-103]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "merged" duplicate handling defined with an unambiguous priority order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-102]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the search matching rule (fields, case, diacritics, minimum length, cap, grouping order) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-113]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "playable" defined in one place and used consistently by scopes and counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-118, §FR-111]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the count shown for a locked pack before purchase unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-111, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the meaning of "within 1 second" for unlocking tied to a defined start event? [Clarity, Spec §FR-107, §SC-105]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Do FR-122 and FR-123 amend feature 001's FR-068 and FR-065 explicitly, with no other conflict left in feature 001's privacy requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-122, §FR-123]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is Random's no-repeat rule consistent with feature 001 FR-088 for one-preset scopes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-117, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is FR-110 (no stored unlock flag) consistent with the offline requirement in FR-107? [Consistency, Spec §FR-107, §FR-110]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are alphabetical ordering rules consistent between lists, Favorites and scopes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-114, §FR-115, §FR-117]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Can SC-101's index-ready time be measured from a defined event on named devices? [Measurability, Spec §SC-101]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-103's scrolling criterion quantified (frames on time, duration, lists)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-103]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-106's random-pick property stated so it can be verified automatically? [Measurability, Spec §SC-106]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-108's size limit tied to a defined baseline (release 1.0) and measurement (installed size)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-108]
- [ ] CHK021 - Does SC-107 define "behave exactly as in release 1.0" precisely enough to test (order, favorites)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-107]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 - Are restore scenarios covered for a new device and for an account with no purchase? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for a stored scope that no longer resolves after an update? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for favorites of presets removed by a pack update? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are Ask to Buy approvals that arrive while the app runs covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-108]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are accessibility requirements specified for locks, scope changes, the purchase sheet and search results? [Coverage, Spec §FR-124]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the "no analytics, accounts, tracking or servers" constraint stated so the privacy review can check it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-122]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are performance requirements specified for the reference device and the lowest-end device (D3)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-101, §SC-102]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the license-basis assumption recorded with its risk and a fallback (dropping a pack)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are owner-only dependencies (App Store Connect product, Paid Apps agreement) identified as outside the app's scope? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Spec edits made while generating this checklist (owner delegated decisions, 2026-11-10): SC-101
  measured from the source chooser's first appearance; SC-103 quantified (95% of frames on time over
  10 s on the longest lists); FR-113 group order and one-character search; restricted purchases
  edge case; Family Sharing off assumption. CHK023 is covered by data-model.md's scope transitions;
  the spec has no line for it yet.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
